parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The log category. Valid values:

*   dcdn_log_access_l1 (default): access logs.
*   dcdn_log_er: Edge Routine logs.
*   dcdn_log_waf: firewall logs.
*   dcdn_log_ipa: TCP/UDP proxy logs.

parameters.name: FieldName
parameters.description: The log fields that you want to include in logs to be delivered. Separate the log fields with commas (,).

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the delivery task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-user-delivery-task --task-name test_project --field-name ClientRequestID,ClientRequestHost --business-type dcdn_log_er --discard-rate 0.0 --details example-string --filter-ver example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateUserDeliveryTask --region cn-hangzhou --FilterVer 'example-string' --DiscardRate '0.0' --Details 'example-string' --TaskName test_project --BusinessType dcdn_log_er --FieldName 'ClientRequestID,ClientRequestHost'
